subject: SOC 2 Type II kickoff: report window, bridge letter options, and quick reply templates
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II kickoff: report window, bridge letter options, and quick reply templates

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. To keep your procurement review moving, can you confirm whether Fathom Health can accept our SOC 2 Type II report for the audit period ending 2026-12-31 (the report we expect to provide) or whether you need a report covering a different window?

Practical asks from our side so we can share the right artifacts securely:
- If you accept a 2026-12-31 Type II report, we will provide: the full SOC 2 Type II PDF, our bridge letter (if the report date is older than your requested window), a one-page system description, and an evidence index (high-level list, not raw artifacts).
- If you need live evidence or more granular artifacts during the audit window, we can set up secure transfer methods (SFTP, SharePoint/Drive with restricted access, or secure pre-signed links).
- Please let us know your preferred transfer method and any recipient emails for the secure share.

To speed things up, I attached: a quick asset-inventory template (fill only the green fields), secure-upload instructions for our SFTP/Drive options, and short reply templates your team can use if you want an immediate yes/no on acceptance.

Target timeline: if we can confirm scope this week, we can upload the report + bridge letter by EOD Friday (2027-04-30). If you need more time or a contractor review, please flag.

Sample quick points you can send back (feel free to use the templates attached):
- "We accept the 2026-12-31 SOC 2 Type II report; please share the PDF and bridge letter via the secure link."
- "We need evidence for [specific control areas]; please provide an evidence index and we will request only the artifacts needed."

Let me know and I’ll have the files staged.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2-asset-inventory-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), secure-upload-instructions.pdf (PDF), reply-templates.docx (Word)
From: Jordan Mills <jmills@fathomhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fathomhealth.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II kickoff: report window, bridge letter options, and quick reply templates

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear note and the templates. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
1) Audit window: For our risk team the preferred coverage window is any report that covers at least through 2026-12-31 and was issued within the last 15 months. If the report was issued earlier, we will accept a bridge letter confirming no material changes.
2) Data residency: do you have controls that specifically speak to EU/UK data handling? We only need to confirm our legal team that there’s no cross-border hosting for PHI in our scope (we handle de-identified patient data, but want to be explicit).
3) Transfer: SFTP is fine. Please provide the upload user and expected folder structure and we’ll circulate to our security mailbox.

If you can send the report PDF + bridge letter and the one-page system description, that will probably let us close the initial review. For any evidence requests we might follow up with a narrow list (e.g., change management tickets, personnel access matrix) after the SOC review.

Jordan Mills
Security Manager, Fathom Health
jmills@fathomhealth.com
